basis.method: damped straight-line trend of weekly demand (orders plus turned away), times a market-context factor; range = 1.28 x weekly scatter x 2

note: An estimate from recent weeks, not a forecast. The market-context effect is an assumption, not a measured fact.
text: For 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-08 we project 56 to 56 orders, most likely about 56. This is an estimate from your recent weeks, not a forecast. It uses your last 8 weeks (trend +0.04 a week) and a context factor of 1.123 from india_festivals. Demand windows in that period: Dussehra (2026-10-13 to 2026-10-20), Diwali (Deepavali) (2026-11-01 to 2026-11-08). Demand is about 73 orders (62 to 85), more than the 56 you can make at 14 a week. Demand is expected to exceed what you can make: about 17 orders would be turned away. Capacity is what limits these weeks: plan batches or pre-orders now.
